description: Manages the dynamic configuration and schema definition of entities and their fields within the system. This includes creating, updating, and retrieving entity structures and their associated field properties.

endpoints.name: GetEntities
endpoints.description: Get all available entities for dropdown selection.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all configurable entities?
Show me the entities that can be selected in a dropdown.
I need a list of all system entities for a UI component.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a simple list of all entities configured in the system, typically for populating dropdowns or selection lists in a user interface.

endpoints.name: GetEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get entity configuration details by entity name for the frontend screen.
example_uses: Retrieve the configuration details for the 'Partner' entity.
I need to see how the 'Project' entity is configured, including its fields.
Show me the schema definition for the 'Contact' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the detailed configuration, including field definitions, for a specific entity by its name. This is typically used to dynamically render forms or display entity structures on a frontend.

endpoints.name: SaveEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Save entity configuration (entity description and field configurations).
example_uses: Save the updated configuration for the 'Vendor' entity.
I want to persist changes to the 'Asset' entity's description and field settings.
Update the configuration of the 'User' entity with new field definitions.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update or save the entire configuration of an existing entity, including its general description and the definitions of its fields. This is a comprehensive save operation.

endpoints.name: GetAllEntityConfigurations
endpoints.description: Get all entity configurations (for admin purposes).
example_uses: List all configured entities and their full configurations.
As an administrator, I need to see all entity schemas.
Retrieve a complete overview of all entity configurations in the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a comprehensive list of all entity configurations, including their detailed field definitions. This is typically used for administrative overview or system-wide configuration management.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityConfiguration
example_uses: Create a new entity configuration for 'Project Task'.
Define a new data model for 'Support Ticket'.
I need to add a new configurable entity to the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to define and create a brand new entity configuration within the system. This allows for the introduction of new data models.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityConfiguration
example_uses: Update the entity configuration with ID 123.
Modify the details of an existing entity configuration.
I want to change the properties of the entity configuration identified by its ID.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify an existing entity configuration identified by its unique ID. This is for targeted updates to a specific entity's definition.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityConfiguration
example_uses: Delete the entity configuration with ID 456.
Remove the 'Old Feature' entity configuration from the system.
I need to permanently delete an entity definition.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an entity configuration from the system, identified by its unique ID. Exercise caution as this action is irreversible.

endpoints.name: GetEntityFields
endpoints.description: Get fields for a specific entity configuration.
example_uses: Retrieve all fields associated with the entity configuration ID 789.
Show me the field definitions for the 'Product' entity configuration.
I need a list of fields for a specific entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve only the field definitions for a specific entity configuration, identified by its manager ID. This is useful when you only need the schema of fields, not the full entity configuration.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityField
example_uses: Add a new 'Status' field to the 'Order' entity.
Define a new custom field for an existing entity.
I want to create a new field within an entity's configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to add a new field definition to an existing entity configuration. This allows for extending the data model of an entity.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityField
example_uses: Update the entity field with ID 101.
Modify the properties of an existing field, like its data type or label.
I need to change the definition of a specific entity field.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify the properties of an existing entity field, identified by its unique ID. This is for targeted updates to a specific field's definition.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityField
example_uses: Delete the entity field with ID 202.
Remove the 'Temporary Notes' field from the 'Task' entity.
I need to permanently delete a specific field from an entity's configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an entity field from its configuration, identified by its unique ID. Exercise caution as this action is irreversible.

endpoints.name: GetRelatedEntityFields
endpoints.description: Get available fields for a related entity type (for relationship field configuration).
example_uses: Show me the fields available for linking to the 'User' entity type.
What fields can I use to establish a relationship with the 'Department' entity?
Retrieve fields from a related entity for configuring a relationship field.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to discover available fields from a specified related entity type. This is crucial when configuring relationship fields, allowing you to select which fields from the related entity can be referenced.

endpoints.name: GetFieldOptionsForDataType
endpoints.description: Get field options for a specific data type in the context of an entity.
example_uses: What are the available options for a 'string' data type field in the context of the 'Product' entity?
Show me the field options for a 'boolean' type within the 'Settings' entity.
Retrieve configuration options for a field based on its data type and the entity it belongs to.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve specific configuration options or constraints applicable to a field based on its data type (e.g., 'string', 'integer', 'boolean') and the entity it's being configured for. This helps in dynamic form generation or validation.

endpoints.name: GetEntityListViewConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get list view configuration for an entity (for dynamic column generation).
example_uses: Retrieve the list view settings for the 'Order' entity.
What columns should be displayed in the list view for 'Customers'?
Show me the configuration for generating the table view of the 'Invoice' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the specific configuration that dictates how an entity's data should be displayed in a list or table view, including which columns to show and their order. This is essential for dynamic UI rendering of data grids.
